name: Linen
overview: Scripture reveals that linen was a valuable and symbolically significant material in biblical times, used in both practical and sacred contexts. Pharaoh clothed Joseph in fine linen, signifying honor and authority (Genesis 41:42), while the tabernacle’s curtains and priestly vestments were made of finely twined linen, often combined with blue, purple, and scarlet, highlighting its role in worship and holiness (Exodus 26:1; 28:5-7). Linen also served in royal livery and bedding, underscoring its broad use and importance in daily life and ceremonial functions.
